question.text: A Cat III AIF's assets include:

answer.text: Cash, securities, dividends/interest receivable, derivative financial rights, provisional expenses, and all other assets

explanation.text: The Logic: The fund assets list includes cash/bank holdings, securities and investments, dividends/distributions receivable, interest, derivative financial rights, qualifying provisional expenses, and all other assets including prepaid expenditure. The Trap: Narrow lists confined to cash, deposits, or receivables miss several legitimate categories of fund assets. Note: Derivative financial rights are part of the comprehensive asset definition.
